exposure: Age of sexual assault (teenage vs. adult)
Sexual violence as teenagers (12-19 years of age)
maternal distress during labor and delivery
outcome: Maternal distress during labor and delivery
cohort: 1068 women who attended a Rape Trauma Service (RTS) in Iceland between 1993 and 2010 and delivered at least one singleton infant.
finding: Women with a history of sexual assault, particularly as teenagers, are at increased risks of some adverse obstetric outcomes, including maternal distress during labor and delivery, prolonged first stage of labor, antepartum bleeding, and emergency instrumental delivery.
mod_finding: Women with a history of sexual assault, particularly as teenagers, did not have a significantly different risk of elective Cesarean section compared to women without such history.
